versions.changelog:
Initial release of skill-ten-prompt-generator.

- Added a comprehensive Chinese-language guide (SKILL.md) for creating, using, and managing Agent Skills in Claude Code.
- Documentation covers prerequisites, skill structure, usage scenarios, best practices, troubleshooting, and team sharing workflows.
- Includes instructions for personal, project, and plugin-based skills.
- Details YAML frontmatter requirements and allowed-tools restrictions for enhanced security.
- Provides practical examples, command-line usage, and debugging guidance throughout.
